export function isBetaEntry(game){return game?.type==='beta-local'&&game.releaseStatus==='beta-local'&&game.verified===false&&game.beta?.localOnly===true&&/^gn-[0-9]+$/.test(game.id)&&game.url===`/arcade-beta/runtime/${game.id}/index.beta.html`;}
export function isLibraryEntry(game){return game.disabled!==true&&!RETIRED_GAME_IDS.includes(game.id)&&(isBetaEntry(game)||game.verified===true||(game.releaseStatus==='awaiting-user-gameplay'&&game.verification?.launch==='verified-stage2'));}
